scripts.reset: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -print -exec rm -rf '{}' \; && pnpm store prune && rm -rf apps/unity-compendium/.next apps/unity-admin/.next
scripts.env-pull: pnpm exec turbo run env-pull && vercel env pull .env.local
scripts.env-pull-production: pnpm exec turbo run env-pull-production && vercel env pull --environment=production .env.local
scripts.watch: concurrently "pnpm --filter @unity/node-scripts watch" "pnpm --filter @unity/mongodb watch" "pnpm --filter @unity/components watch" "pnpm --filter @unity/models watch" "pnpm --filter @unity/hooks watch" "pnpm --filter @unity/api-methods watch"

descriptions.dev-all: Start Compendium on port 3000 & Admin on port 3001
descriptions.build: Lint and build on all workspaces
descriptions.reset: Find and delete all node modules and .next
descriptions.env-pull-production: pull production env for multiple workspaces
descriptions.watch: Watches for changes done in packages or sdk typescript files
descriptions.package-vitality: Check for outdated packages in all workspaces
